description: Current avalanche danger for every US avalanche forecast zone (about 90 zones from about 30 centers), or one state or center, sorted highest first, with counts by danger level, off-season zones, the validity window of each rating and avalanche warnings.

center.description: One avalanche center id, for example NWAC, UAC, CAIC, SNFAC.

min_level.description: Only zones at or above this danger level, 1 Low to 5 Extreme.

rated_only.description: Only zones that have a danger rating right now.

state.description: US state, 2-letter code or name, for example WA, UT or Colorado.

name: avalanche_danger_map
title: Avalanche danger map
